resources.string: Conditions within the same category match ANY; different categories must ALL match. All selected rule-set references match ANY, and must also match together with the other conditions, including destination IP. Rule sets retain their internal logic. Use IP-only sets for source matching. Complex connection rules are not copied to DNS.
Import a .srs or .json file from the rule-set files page first.
Import a valid .srs binary or .json source rule set. Database files are not supported.
This file is referenced by a routing rule. Remove that reference before deleting the file.
Some routing rules cannot be safely applied to DNS. They and subsequent rules remain connection-only; DNS uses its configured default.

Remote rules include disabled rules. Pull down to download all. Successful manual downloads are used on the next connection; reconnect an active VPN to use them. The core still checks remote rules every 24 hours while running. Times below refer to manual downloads, not live core updates.
No rule resources. Add a remote rule set in a routing rule, or import a local SRS/JSON file with the toolbar button.
